nodes.label: Physics Accumulator & Tick
nodes.rationale: Game logic runs inside a 30Hz tick loop (timeStep={1/30}). Physics accumulator prevents death spirals by limiting catch-up ticks to 10 per frame.

nodes.label: 144Hz Visual Interpolation
nodes.rationale: Smooths guest player and swarm positions by interpolating visuals using a Snapshot Buffer in useFrame to hide network latency.

nodes.label: IndexedDB Chunk Persistence
nodes.rationale: Prefixes chunk keys by saveSlotId. Saves Uint32Array(81920) buffers compressed via Run-Length Encoding (RLE) to decrease disk I/O.

nodes.label: Web Worker Structured Clone Rules
nodes.rationale: Avoid referencing detached buffers by making copies when neighbor checks are pending. Safely copy Web Worker payloads on the main thread. Avoid using for...in loops for copying typed arrays.
